count.markdownDescription: Particle count at a quality multiplier of 1.

kind.description: Follows the camera in XZ only; Y is the fixed world band `centerY ± size.y / 2`.
kind.markdownDescription: Follows the camera in XZ only; Y is the fixed world band `centerY ± size.y / 2`.

offset.description: XZ of the slab centre relative to the camera.
offset.markdownDescription: XZ of the slab centre relative to the camera.

distributionY.description:
Skews spawn origins along the band instead of spreading them evenly, so a tall band can stay
sparse where it matters less: `power` 1 is uniform, higher packs harder toward `toward`.
Shapes origins only; long vertical drifts carry particles back out of it.

volume.description:

axis that follows the camera breathes as the camera moves along it (a jump, for a short box).

lifetime.description: Seconds before a particle respawns at a new origin. Omit for immortal drifters.

sizePx.description: Projected size clamp in pixels; below `min` the sprite grows and dims to preserve coverage. Default: min 1.5, max 128
sizePx.markdownDescription: Projected size clamp in pixels; below `min` the sprite grows and dims to preserve coverage. Default: min 1.5, max 128

softDepth.description:
Depth-fades each sprite as an ellipsoid whose depth radius is `softDepth` × its screen radius
(1 = sphere), by the fraction of its view-ray chord lying between the near plane and the
geometry behind it, so large soft sprites don't cut walls in hard lines. Depth-tests per
fragment in the shader instead of in hardware, so leave it off for dense systems of tiny sprites.

renderScale.description:
Draw into a buffer this fraction of the viewport and composite it back with a depth-aware
upsample, capping the fill cost of screen-filling soft sprites. Needs `softDepth`; `scene` output only.

affects.markdownDescription: What the gate scales. `density` thins particles stochastically at constant size. Default: `alpha`

gate.description:

a horizontal plane: `skyExposed` looks down from `planeY` (rain dies under cover), `floorExposed`
looks up from it (dust rising out of a fog floor stops under platforms). Backed by a
camera-following height map that systems with identical settings share.
